results.title: Mechanical Keyboard Switch Tester: Hear and Compare
results.content:
Mechanical keyboard switches are the heart of any mechanical keyboard, determining how each key press feels, sounds and responds. This mechanical keyboard switch tester lets you hear and compare twelve popular switches without buying a single one. Pick a switch, press Play sound or type in the box, and add up to four switches to the comparison table to see their force, travel and actuation point side by side. Use the keyboard polling rate test to benchmark your keyboard's actual polling rate against its spec sheet.

## How to Use the Mechanical Keyboard Switch Tester [...] 1. Filter the grid by brand (Cherry MX, Gateron, Kailh, Holy Panda or Zealios) or by type (linear, tactile or clicky), or leave both on All.
2. Click a switch card. It becomes the selected switch, its specs appear on the right and its sound plays once.
3. Click inside the typing box and type. Each key press plays the selected switch's press sound and each release plays its release sound.
4. Choose Add to compare for up to four switches, then read the comparison table to see how they differ.

Use the volume slider if the sound is too loud or too soft, and Reset to clear the filters, the comparison table and the typing box.

results.title: MechKey · Mechanical Keyboard Sound Test & Switch Simulator
results.content:
MechKey needs JavaScript and WebGL to show the 3D keyboard. The guide below still works without it.

# A mechanical keyboard sound test you can play with

MechKey is a free keyboard sound tester that runs in your browser. Type on your own keyboard, or click the keys of the
3D keyboard on the desk, and hear what different mechanical switches sound like before you buy them. Every sound is a
real recording of a real switch.

### How to use it

### The switches

The Cherry MX and Topre recordings were made on PBT keycaps, which usually sound deeper than thinner ABS caps.

### Questions

#### Linear, tactile or clicky: what's the difference? [...] #### Does it work on phones and tablets?

Yes. Tap the keys on the 3D keyboard to hear them. The typing test works best with a physical keyboard.

#### Is it free?

Yes. MechKey is free with no sign-up, and nothing you type is sent anywhere.
